opening.label: Before the march
opening.text: The army is on the New Jersey bank, forming for the march. The crossing ran about three hours late.

sides.name: British Crown forces (British and German troops)

units.name: Washington's army (Trenton force)
units.label: Washington
units.notes: The whole crossing force. Brigade strengths are not in the sources read (TG03).

units.name: Washington's headquarters
units.label: Washington (HQ)
units.notes: Rode with Greene's division.

units.name: Greene's division (left wing)
units.label: Greene
units.notes: Upper column, by the Scotch and Pennington roads. Wiederhold's sketch marks "Gen. Greene's Brigade" (U) at the head of the town.

units.name: Sullivan's division (right wing)
units.label: Sullivan
units.notes: Lower column, by the River Road. Wiederhold's sketch marks "Gen. Sullivan's Brigade" (Q).

units.name: Stephen's brigade
units.label: Stephen
units.notes: Advance of the army. Scott's and Lawson's battalions named in S22.

units.name: Lord Stirling's brigade
units.label: Stirling
units.notes: Reserve of the left wing. Weedon's regiment named in S33.

assignments.commander: Brig. Gen. William Alexander, Lord Stirling

units.name: De Fermoy's brigade
units.label: Fermoy
units.notes: Hand's riflemen and the German Battalion (S20 note 7; S33). Not marked on Wiederhold's sketch.

assignments.commander: Brig. Gen. Matthias Alexis Roche de Fermoy

units.name: Glover's brigade
units.label: Glover
units.notes: Glover's own 14th Continental Regiment manned the boats (S33).

units.name: Sargent's brigade
units.label: Sargent
units.notes: No position during the attack in the sources read (TG04).

units.name: Capt. William Washington's advance party
units.label: W. Washington
units.notes: 3rd Virginia Regiment (S33). Lt. James Monroe was with it.

units.name: Bauman's battery
units.label: Bauman
units.notes: No position during the attack in the sources read (TG04).

units.name: Neil's battery
units.label: Neil
units.notes: No position during the attack in the sources read (TG04).

units.name: Hugg's battery
units.label: Hugg
units.notes: No position during the attack in the sources read (TG04).

units.name: Sargent's battery
units.label: Sargent (bty)
units.notes: No position during the attack in the sources read (TG04).

units.name: Ewing's brigade (Pennsylvania militia)
units.label: Ewing
units.notes: Did not cross. Was to seize the Assunpink bridge.

units.name: Cadwalader's force
units.label: Cadwalader
units.notes: Did not complete its crossing from Bristol.

units.name: Rall's brigade
units.label: Rall
units.notes: Garrison of Trenton. See TC06 on its strength.

units.name: Rall regiment
units.label: Rall Regt
units.notes: The regiment "of the day" on 26 December.

units.name: Von Lossberg regiment
units.label: Lossberg
units.notes: Lt. Col. Scheffer and Maj. von Hanstein surrendered the Rall and Lossberg regiments (S22).

units.name: Von Knyphausen regiment
units.label: Knyphausen
units.notes: Wiederhold's own regiment.

units.name: 16th Light Dragoons (detachment)
units.label: 16 LD
units.notes: The only British troops in the garrison.

units.name: Von Lossberg regiment's guns
units.label: Lossberg guns
units.notes: Six 3-pounders in the brigade (S21; S34).

units.name: Pennington road picket

units.name: Maidenhead road picket

units.name: Crosswicks drawbridge detachment
units.label: Crosswicks
units.notes: About 7 miles from Trenton; off the battle map.

events.name: March begins
events.text: The column sets off from the landing for Trenton, about nine miles away.

events.name: Army divides
events.text: At Birmingham Greene takes the upper road and Sullivan the River Road.

events.name: First shots
events.text: Greene's advance drives in Lt. Wiederhold's picket on the Pennington road.

events.name: Sullivan's attack
events.text: About three minutes later the lower column strikes the jäger picket at the Hermitage.

events.name: Guns open
events.text: Forrest's and Hamilton's batteries open from the head of King and Queen Streets.

events.name: Line of battle
events.text: The three Hessian regiments form a line along the east edge of the village.

events.name: Hessian guns taken
events.label: Guns taken
events.text: The Rall regiment's two guns are lost on King Street, just north of the headquarters.

events.name: Rall shot
events.text: Rall leads two regiments back into the town and is mortally wounded on Queen Street.

events.name: Surrender in the orchard
events.label: Surrender
events.text: The Rall and von Lossberg regiments lay down their arms east of the town.

events.name: Knyphausen surrenders
events.text: The Knyphausen regiment, cut off from the bridge, surrenders by the Assunpink.
